scope: Street entrance/light tower and a bounded immediately adjacent curved left return only. No auditorium, full commercial strip, neighboring coffee-shop block or rear tower.

observations.capture_context: Commons metadata dates capture to 2010-05-07; daylight oblique street photograph by Pyzhou.
direct_observations: A pale rectangular panelled light/sign tower rises at the left edge of the principal entrance, with dark GRAND THEATRE lettering stacked vertically on the visible front face.
The entrance has a broad low horizontal canopy; dark framed door glazing sits beneath it. Its upper glazing is largely obscured by temporary movie advertising in this photograph.
Cream horizontal rounded bands on the immediately adjacent left return meet the tower area. Repeated tall pale fins project above the entrance glazing at the right of the tower.

The facade strip continues farther left than the bounded candidate scope. The coffee-shop block at the right and taller building behind the entrance do not establish cinema ownership or candidate inclusion.
limits: Oblique perspective and foreground objects prevent reliable metric scaling.
This photograph cannot verify the currently restored upper glazing; use the other two references for that feature.
Film-poster artwork, street signs, cars, people, trees, rear tower and neighboring coffee-shop block are excluded from the candidate.

direct_observations: Large dark upper entrance glazing is divided by slender, light-colored vertical members and rises directly over a projecting horizontal marquee.
The canopy soffit shows a visible orthogonal grid. The fascia bears spaced GRAND THEATRE letters.
The immediately adjacent left facade returns in several smooth horizontal cream bands, with dark inset surfaces between them.
Ground-floor entrance glazing is framed into door/window units; the photo also includes temporary display boards and several tall illuminated rectangular fixtures.
limits: The entrance and canopy are cropped, and the full tower is outside the frame.
Exact image date, subsequent repairs, material colors and dimensions are unverified.
Visible display boards and lettering typography are not sufficient evidence for exact reproduction.

limits: Night illumination does not directly establish daylight glass color, stone color, emission intensity or physical material properties.
